date: Nov 15, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 7 · Synthesis and spiral review

cards.title: One release, one risk picture
cards.question: Four teams report green, but PCIe margin is shrinking. What do you tell the release owner?
cards.selfCheck: Integrate evidence across teams; lead with release exposure, not individual status. Exercise: give a 20-second risk headline, confidence level and decision deadline.
cards.prompt: Role-play a release owner questioning my Week 1 synthesis: PCIe Gen5 margin shrinking despite green team dashboards. Score my risk-first update and decision ask.

cards.title: Confidence is not permission
cards.question: EM predicts 53 Ω and TDR reads 55 Ω. Can you sign off the channel?
cards.selfCheck: Separate confidence in the measurement from confidence in the system decision. Exercise: specify the decisive correlation test, tolerance and owner before signoff.
cards.prompt: Challenge my conditional SI signoff decision for a 53-ohm EM versus 55-ohm TDR mismatch. Require evidence thresholds and accountable owners.

cards.title: The handoff is the failure mode
cards.question: A 19 MHz PDN peak spans VRM, board and package. Who closes the risk?
cards.selfCheck: Name one integration owner, with VRM, board and package evidence due at a shared checkpoint. Exercise: write a three-line ownership agreement and escalation trigger.
cards.prompt: Coach me through assigning cross-functional ownership of a 19 MHz PDN resonance before release. Critique my closure plan and escalation threshold.

cards.title: Don't offer an unbounded maybe
cards.question: A 3 dB NEXT miss has reroute and shielding options. What is your freeze recommendation?
cards.selfCheck: Compare predicted margin, schedule cost and validation uncertainty. Exercise: choose a preferred path, fallback and latest responsible decision time.
cards.prompt: Act as layout lead and program manager challenging my reroute-versus-shield decision for a 3 dB NEXT miss at layout freeze.

cards.title: The 60-second Principal brief
cards.question: Can you turn a week of SI/PI risks into one decision-ready recommendation?
cards.selfCheck: State recommendation, top two risks, confidence, owners and next gate. Exercise: deliver in 60 seconds; then reduce it to a 15-second executive version.
cards.prompt: Run a Week 1 Principal Engineer capstone. Give me a director's release-gate scenario with PCIe, EM/TDR, PDN and crosstalk risks; score my 60-second and 15-second briefs.
